worldsmith.config.api_key.tooltip: Stored in plain text in config/worldsmith.json. For AWS Bedrock this is the access key id.
worldsmith.config.api_key.tooltip.env: Leave blank to read %s from the environment instead.
worldsmith.config.api_secret.tooltip: AWS Bedrock only: the secret access key.
worldsmith.config.base_url.tooltip: Leave blank to use the provider's default endpoint. Set this to point at a local or proxied server.
worldsmith.config.max_output_tokens.tool: An upper bound on one reply. A whole biome plan needs several thousand.
worldsmith.config.mcp.about: Lets an external assistant read and write Worldsmith packs while the game is running. It listens on this machine only and is never reachable from the network.
worldsmith.config.mcp.autoApprove.toolti: On by default: a connected assistant may compile and run its own Java for this world without a confirmation. The worker limits time and memory, but it is not a filesystem or network sandbox and the code runs under your account. Turn this off to be asked once per authoring session.
worldsmith.config.mcp.discovery: Running bridges announce themselves in %s, so an agent can read the address from there instead of being told it. The file disappears when the bridge stops.
worldsmith.config.mcp.enabled.tooltip: Off by default. Turning this on opens a local port for as long as the game is running.
worldsmith.config.mcp.port.tooltip: The port to prefer. If it is busy the bridge takes the next free one, so the address below is what actually bound. The bridge restarts when you save.
worldsmith.config.model.tooltip: Leave blank to use the provider's default model.
worldsmith.config.provider.tooltip: Which API to speak. OPENAI_COMPATIBLE covers Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, DeepSeek and OpenRouter.
worldsmith.config.region.tooltip: AWS Bedrock only. Ignored by every other provider.
worldsmith.config.timeout_seconds.toolti: Seconds to wait for one reply before giving up.

worldsmith.progress.following_manual: PINNED · Showing your selected world session
worldsmith.progress.pause.hint: Pause this panel only. The AI and drawing jobs keep running.
worldsmith.progress.resume.hint: Resume cached progress updates for this panel.
worldsmith.progress.paused: VIEW PAUSED · The AI may still be working
worldsmith.progress.category.hint: Cycle target categories. Counts and progress remain based on the complete plan.
worldsmith.progress.disconnected: BRIDGE OFFLINE · No fresh authoring data
worldsmith.progress.empty_title: Your world plan will appear here
worldsmith.progress.empty_auto: Ask your AI to begin or resume a Worldsmith world session, or select one with the session picker. No old world is selected automatically just because it exists.
worldsmith.progress.empty_manual: The chosen session has no live view on this bridge. Resume that session or explicitly choose another; the panel will not silently switch worlds.
worldsmith.progress.not_an_ai_runner: This tab observes existing AI work. It does not start an AI request, execute source code or create a world.
worldsmith.progress.no_plan_progress: Plan target total not yet established
worldsmith.progress.progress_boundary: Draft coverage, not a gameplay-completion percentage. Extra definitions do not fill missing plan targets.
worldsmith.progress.no_plan_boundary: Without an exact plan denominator, no completion percentage is inferred. Cards show submitted definitions.
worldsmith.progress.native_boundary: Native activation is checked separately for this screen and selected bundle. Historical receipts are not current activation.
worldsmith.progress.no_targets: No planned targets in this category.
worldsmith.progress.targets_need_plan: Submit a named world plan to see individual targets and draft coverage.
worldsmith.progress.targets_truncated: The target list is bounded. An oversized plan does not receive a fabricated completion denominator.
worldsmith.progress.no_jobs: No drawing jobs are recorded for this session.
worldsmith.progress.approval_hint: Waiting for your source-execution approval in the host prompt; this panel does not grant approval.
worldsmith.progress.jobs_more: Showing up to 6 jobs, active work first. The cached snapshot contains more job details.
worldsmith.progress.issues_more: More diagnostics are available in the generation-progress tool response.
worldsmith.progress.verification_boundar: Declared and frozen states describe saved draft records. They do not prove a fresh geometry/texture check, a ready resource pack or in-game completion.
worldsmith.progress.card_hint: Counts are declared plan targets / planned targets. %s extra definitions are not counted as planned progress.
